priority:P0.description: Mission Control critical path; maximum 3 open PRs

priority:P1.description: Mission Control next-important work; maximum 7 open PRs

state:ready.description: Real checks are green and the PR is not a draft

state:needs-fix.description: At least one real, repairable check is failing

agent:working.description: PR Doctor dispatched a repair for the current head SHA

state:waiting-human.description: Explicit human decision or approval is required

stack:blocked.description: Blocked by an explicit stack/dependency boundary

state:superseded.description: Replaced by a newer PR; candidate for governed cleanup
